Native-safe replacements documented: (1) react-i18next -> useSettingsTranslation fallback (keys+English fallbacks preserved verbatim; {{var}} interpolation for the draft banner). (2) useToast -> Alert.alert(title, message) (the established native toast primitive; success/info/error call sites preserved). (3) useFormDraft -> in-memory mirror of {value,setValue,hasDraft,draftSavedAt,discardDraft,flush}; localStorage persistence + BroadcastChannel cross-tab crash-recovery are browser-only and UNAVAILABLE on native (hasDraft stays false -> the component takes the hydrate-from-server path); discardDraft resets to initial, flush is a no-op. (4) useNavigationGuard -> no-op (the react-router in-app confirm dialog has no native analog). (5) CurrencyInput -> CurrencyField: the micro-unit storage + Intl.NumberFormat format + locale-aware parse-on-blur/submit contract is reproduced (the currencyFormat helpers are ported); the DOM focus/keyDown wiring becomes onFocus/onBlur/onSubmitEditing. (6) FadeIn -> renders children statically in their final state (no Animated timers) following the Toggle/Checkbox 'deterministic under --detectOpenHandles' idiom; the delay prop is accepted for source parity.

Verified NO DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (div/h2/p/span/label/button/input/select), lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, clsx, react-i18next, framer-motion, react-router, or old web ui/forms components are imported -- only react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator/Alert/Modal/Pressable/ScrollView/TextInput/View) plus the existing shared native AppText, GlassPanel and theme tokens (colors/shadows/spacing), and the native useSettings hooks. All state names (form/setForm/hasDraft/draftSavedAt/discardDraft/saved/formInited/isDirty), the DEFAULT_FORM + CURRENCY_SYMBOL_TO_ISO maps, symbolToIsoCode, syncUnitsFromCar logic, the skipPersist/isDirty JSON diffs, the formInited hydration guard, and every i18n key + English fallback are preserved.
